about_the_game:
In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, recruit powerful allies, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction. The fate of the realm lies in your hands—prepare for a journey filled with epic dungeons, intense PVP, and towering world bosses. Will you conquer the darkness or be consumed by it?

Game Features:

[Core Combat System]

Idle questing: No need to grind or spend excessively. Play at your own pace while progressing through levels.

[Character System]

Hero progression and skill enhancement. A wide variety of heroes and skills to mix and match.

[Equipment System]

Strengthen your gear for explosive power. Collect resources, upgrade equipment, and boost combat strength.

[Treasure Chest System]

A wealth of resources is waiting for you. Unlock mysterious treasure chests to claim a massive amount of rewards.

[Dungeon System]

World Bosses and PvP duels. Take on various dungeons and face powerful bosses to earn generous rewards.

[Guild System]

Join forces and build greatness together. Team up with guildmates to conquer challenges and achieve glory.

Embark on your dark fantasy adventure now—defeat, conquer, and rise to the top!

  • DirectX: Version 9.0
